title: Kingston Sunset Sessions
summary: A rooftop evening of live reggae, craft cocktails, and skyline views in New Kingston.
description: Kingston Sunset Sessions brings together local artists, DJ sets, and a polished rooftop atmosphere for guests who want an easy, stylish night out. Expect live performances, curated food stations, and a late-evening crowd that feels social without being chaotic.

title: Portland Wellness Weekend
summary: Three days of guided movement, coastal breakfasts, and restorative sessions near the sea.
description: Designed for guests who want a softer pace, Portland Wellness Weekend combines yoga flows, sound baths, healthy dining pop-ups, and optional sunrise hikes. It is built to feel premium, calm, and approachable for solo travelers or friend groups.

title: Montego Bay Food & Rum Festival
summary: Chef tastings, local distillers, and live performances celebrating Jamaica's food culture.
description: This festival is a lively culinary showcase with tasting booths, chef-led pairings, rum education sessions, and a stronger premium experience for both locals and travelers. It works well as a trip anchor for visitors already staying in Montego Bay.

description: Built for founders, creatives, and remote-first operators, this retreat pairs strategy sessions with better scenery. Guests can join small-group workshops, coworking hours, fireside conversations, and local coffee experiences across the weekend.
